records.DESCRIPTION:
ABS Non-Conformity : Requirements:  For shipboard daily routing works, the C/O / 2/E shall review the operation risk according to the records of “risk assessment for shipboard operations” (FM-0401-1) to judge whether the current conditions are acceptable or not? Prior to carry out the operation, as per SE management manual risk assessment procedure PR-0401.
Evidence: The following shipboard work and drill activities were conducted, but the risk assessment for shipboard operations (FM-0401-1) were not recorded, there is no evidence that the related risk assessments were carried out: 
 1. Hot work involving gas welding to repair a broken copper pipe on 13 May 2025.
2. Enclosed space work for the inspection and cleaning of the C.D. tank on 14 March 2025.
3. Enclosed space entry and rescue drill on 15 May 2025.
Nature: This serves as objective evidence that risk assessments were not performed in accordance with the company's safety management manual.
